title: Injection coordinate splitting equivalence
statement: Let $A$ be a type, let $M,R$ be natural numbers, and let $e:	ext{Fin}(M)	o	ext{Fin}(R)$ be an injection. The space of $R$-indexed $A$-valued vectors is equivalent to the product of an $M$-indexed $A$-valued vector and an $A$-valued assignment on the coordinates of $	ext{Fin}(R)$ outside the image of $e$.
